title: Clock and score
summary: A timer per question, a time bar, a score and a results screen.
done: You saw a timer, a score and a second screen.

hello.text: In level 3, 10 seconds per question, a score, and a results screen at the end.

tick.text: The **Clock** timer rings every second: the time goes down by 1, the bar too. At 0, it’s too late.

once.text: The **answered** variable (true or false) stops you answering the same question twice.

results.text: After the last question, we open the **Results** screen. Pick it in the list of screens to see its blocks.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Watch [change timeLeft by -1] light up every second.
watch.hint: Tap an answer in the preview, or click “Restart”.

longer.hint: It is [set timeLeft to 10] in “show the question”.

late.text: Show a short message when time is up.
late.hint: Put it in the [if] of “when Clock rings”.
